title: Postbiotics as Next Generation Biotherapeutics Targeting the Gut-Immune-Metabolic Axis: An Integrative Review.
snippet: The gut-immune-metabolic axis has emerged as a central regulator of human health, with growing evidence indicating that microbiota-derived metabolites improve gut microbial ecology, enhance intestinal barrier integrity, reduce systemic inflammation, and maintain metabolic homeostasis.
